mostWorthwhile.text: Building the lymph entry route was most worthwhile: the planned closeup shows fluid and proteins passing through overlapping flaps and explains when the fluid is called lymph.

leastWorthwhile.text: The intermediate collecting-route result was relatively repetitive: it extended the arrows toward a junction already anticipated, without much additional explanation.

surprise.text: The supplied framework paired circulation and breathing control with a comparison showing fluid accumulation when return is inadequate, giving the lymphatic route a concrete purpose.

arbitrary.text: No action felt purposeless, although the menu supplied compatible combinations, so following the route was not a test of discovering compatibility.

continue.text: I would continue: connecting systems and following a physiological consequence through the lymphatic route was interesting, though the final assembly was predictable.
